$description: Analytics scope tokens (added by ds.py init when the analytics scope is enabled). metric.delta.up|down|flat name the TONE of a change (favorable, unfavorable, neutral), not the arrow direction: pick the token from the metric's declared positive direction and keep the arrow and sign from the actual change. Aliases reuse existing semantic text tokens, which already adapt in dark and high-contrast themes, so no themes/ overrides ship. Always pair with an arrow icon, a signed number and text.

up.$description: Favorable change (the metric moved in its positive direction); always paired with an arrow icon and a signed number.

down.$description: Unfavorable change (the metric moved against its positive direction); always paired with an arrow icon and a signed number.

flat.$description: No change or neutral metric; always paired with a flat or arrow icon and a signed number.
